verdict.rationale: The project documents both update paths in the story. The marketplace plugin installs auto-update: Claude Code "updates itself by default" and Codex "updates itself at startup". The file-copy install has an explicit `npx skills update` command for pulling the latest changes without reinstalling, and an ADR describes the plugin as an always-current subscription. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the updates actually work, and documented update behaviour for the Copilot plugin route.
